page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a running head above and page number at top right. No marginal notes beyond faint show-through at the left and right edges, which are left out.

main_text.head: DECLINATIO VERBI actiui secundæ coniugationis.
main_text.l: Io Ténni,& ho Tenúto Ego tenui.
colúi ténne, & ha tenúto ille tenuit.
Nói tenémmo,& habbiámo tenúto Nos tenuimus.

page.notes: Some words in the left column are damaged by the scan edge (for example "Nói teniámo", "Nóiteneuámo"); readings are as far as legible. Marks such as "Io" and "Nói" are printed in italic/roman mix as shown; the leading "Io" and "Nói" forms may be uncertain.
